parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which the resource is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **PHYSICALCONNECTION**: Express Connect circuit.
*   **VIRTUALBORDERROUTER**: virtual border router (VBR).
*   **ROUTERINTERFACE**: router interface.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tags to remove from the specified resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc untag-resources-for-express-connect --resource-type PHYSICALCONNECTION --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --all false --resource-id pc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --tag-key FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc UntagResourcesForExpressConnect --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'pc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000' --TagKey.1 FinanceDept --ResourceType PHYSICALCONNECTION --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
